settings.title: Settings
settings.unsavedChanges: These settings have unsaved changes. Save before closing?
settings.changedExternally: Saved settings changed elsewhere. Your unsaved fields have been kept; saving will apply this draft.

settings.backgroundSyncSuccess: Background sync completed and the latest snippets were refreshed.
settings.webdavDesc: Secure two-way WebDAV merge. HTTPS is required except for localhost, 127.0.0.1, and ::1 development servers.

settings.minimizeToTrayDesc: Clicking the close button minimizes to the system tray
settings.languageDesc: Choose the display language for the app interface

secretAction.replace: Saving will replace the stored credential. The existing value is never shown here.
secretAction.clear: Saving will remove the stored credential and disable credential-backed auto-sync until replaced.

credentialStatus.configured: A credential is stored by the operating system. Leave this field blank to keep it.
credentialStatus.not_configured: No credential is stored. Enter one if the selected authentication mode requires it.
credentialStatus.unavailable: The operating-system credential store is unavailable. Unlock or repair it, then replace or clear the credential.
credentialStatus.denied: Credential access was denied. Grant access, then replace or clear the credential.
credentialStatus.invalid: The credential entry is invalid. Replace or clear it.
credentialStatus.ambiguous: Multiple matching credential entries were found. Clear the duplicates, then replace or clear here.
credentialStatus.migration_required: A legacy credential could not be migrated. The original settings file is preserved; replace or clear the credential before auto-sync resumes.
credentialStatus.recovery_required: A rollback could not be completed. Review the operating-system credential and startup settings, then replace or clear the credential.

recovery.backup_restored: The primary settings file was damaged and quarantined; a valid backup was restored.
recovery.defaults_loaded: The settings file was damaged and quarantined, no valid backup was available, and safe defaults were loaded.

settings.webdavAuthModeDesc: Auto by default (Digest→Basic); switch based on your server
